questionText: i used sacrifice in a 5 might unit, my oppenent used stupefy, how it will resolve?
question: does my unit die / does Sacrifice still go through?

premise.notes: Real Sacrifice (UNL-173) reads 'As an additional cost, kill a friendly Mighty unit. Draw 2 cards, channel a rune.' Per rule 357 / RiftJudge FAQ #9906, additional costs are paid as the spell is PLAYED — before it goes on the chain, and before the opponent gets priority to react. So the 5-Might unit is killed to pay the cost first; only then can the opponent play Stupefy as a Reaction, by which point the unit is in the trash and is no longer a legal Stupefy target. Sacrifice itself does NOT fizzle. Modeled via `additionalCosts` (paid in the pre-pass at play time) — the Channel rune is cosmetic and not modeled.

additionalCosts.source: Sacrifice (additional cost: kill a friendly Mighty unit)
